template: Filter employees by a specific condition (department, status, hire date, etc.)
schema_hint: employees(id, name, email, department_id, hire_date, is_active)

template: Find top-N or bottom-N employees/salaries using ordering and limiting
example_reference_sql: SELECT * FROM employees ORDER BY hire_date ASC LIMIT 5
schema_hint: employees(id, name, email, department_id, hire_date, is_active), salaries(id, employee_id, amount, effective_date)

concept: Aggregate functions (COUNT, AVG, SUM, MIN, MAX)
template: Compute aggregate statistics across employees or salaries
example_reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1
schema_hint: employees(id, name, department_id, is_active), salaries(id, employee_id, amount, effective_date), departments(id, name)

template: Join employees with departments to show combined information
example_reference_sql: SELECT e.name, d.name as department FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
schema_hint: employees(id, name, email, department_id, hire_date, is_active), departments(id, name, location, budget)

template: Group records and filter groups using HAVING clause
example_reference_sql: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM employees GROUP BY department_id HAVING cnt > 3
schema_hint: employees(id, name, department_id, is_active), salaries(id, employee_id, amount, effective_date), departments(id, name)

template: Use a subquery to filter or compute based on an inner query result
example_reference_sql: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM salaries WHERE amount > 100000)
schema_hint: employees(id, name, department_id, is_active), salaries(id, employee_id, amount, effective_date)

template: Use window functions to rank or compare rows without collapsing groups
example_reference_sql: SELECT name, amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) as salary_rank FROM employees e JOIN salaries s ON e.id = s.employee_id WHERE s.effective_date = '2024-01-01'
schema_hint: employees(id, name, department_id), salaries(id, employee_id, amount, effective_date), departments(id, name)
